annotations.title: Judge one page URL against its site's robots.txt for each AI crawler

description: Judges one page URL against its site's robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and CCBot: allowed or not, with the deciding line and Crawl-delay; plus the site's Sitemap URLs. US$0.002 per call; POST url. Costs US$0.002 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/llms.txt

url.description: The http(s) page URL to judge (max 2,048 characters). Only its site's /robots.txt and /llms.txt are read; the page is not fetched.

name: attestpage_access_check

content_signal.description: The Content-Signal line of the robots.txt (contentsignals.org): { search, ai_input, ai_train }, each yes, no or null when the file does not name that signal. Read file-wide, first value per signal wins. null when the file is not served (2xx) or has no Content-Signal line.

crawlers.description: One verdict per crawler: crawler, allowed, user_agent (the lowercase User-agent token used, * when only the wildcard group applies, null when no group applies), deciding_line ({ line, text } of the winning rule, null when no rule matches), crawl_delay (the Crawl-delay in seconds of the group used, null when it has none), reason (which rule decided: rule_matched (a rule of the group used matches the path); no_rule_matched (a group applies but no rule matches); no_group (no group names the crawler or the wildcard, so it is allowed); server_error_disallow (robots.txt answered 5xx, so every crawler is disallowed); unreachable_allow (robots.txt answered another non-2xx, so every crawler is allowed)).

llms_txt.description: The site's /llms.txt: url, http_status (null when it could not be read) and served (true for a 2xx). Reported only: a missing or unreadable /llms.txt never refuses the call or changes a crawler verdict.

network.description: The payment network (CAIP-2 id); null on trial calls.

rail.description: The payment rail (x402); null on trial calls.

robots.description: The robots.txt that was read: url, http_status, served (true for a 2xx) and truncated (true when the file was longer than the 500 KB this check parses, so only its start was judged). A robots.txt that cannot be read (timeout, DNS or connect error, redirect loop) is refused with 502 robots_unreachable, uncharged.

sitemaps.description: The absolute http(s) URLs of the Sitemap lines in the robots.txt, in file order, without repeats (at most 100). Empty when the file is not served (2xx) or declares none.
